{{Short description|Basic structural unit of life}}
{{about|the biological unit}}
The '''cell''' is the [[basic unit|basic structural and functional unit]] of all
known [[organism]]s. A cell is the smallest unit of [[life]].<ref name="alberts">Alberts et al., ''Molecular Biology of the Cell''.</ref> Cells consist of [[cytoplasm]] enclosed within a [[cell membrane|membrane]].

== Structure ==
Most cells contain a [[cell nucleus|nucleus]] and other [[organelle]]s such as
[[mitochondria]] and [[ribosome]]s. The mitochondria generate most of the cell's
supply of [[adenosine triphosphate|ATP]], used as a source of chemical energy.<ref>Energy review.</ref>

<!-- editorial note: expand this section later -->

== Cell types ==
Cells are broadly classified as [[prokaryote|prokaryotic]] or [[eukaryote|eukaryotic]].
